title: T-shirts — Volunteer with sponsorship branding
slide_intent: Show who leads a volunteer activity and who supports it by arranging the marks a person sees on each side of a shirt.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can acknowledge sponsors while retaining visual priority for the accredited program.
demonstration: One volunteer shirt puts program and partner marks on the front. The two-sided version places a large program mark on the front and repeats the identifier above the sponsors on the back.
practical_value: Choose a one-sided layout when the marks remain distinct on the front. Use the reverse for sponsor recognition when the front needs a larger program mark.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy notes
content_islands.spec: Place instructions for single- and double-sided printing and contrast on colored shirts at left.

content_islands.name: Front and back options
content_islands.spec: Pair the single-sided shirt with a front-and-back diagram separated by a dashed vertical rule. Keep sponsors visibly subordinate in scale or position.

content_islands.name: Shirt color variants
content_islands.spec: Compare five shirt colors along the bottom and mark the light-on-dark and dark-on-light treatments.
